description.fun: Nobody knows what Tangela looks like under its tangle of blue vines, which never stop growing. The vines sway constantly, unnerving enemies and tickling anything they catch, and they snap off painlessly if grabbed, so Tangela can always slip away and grow new ones. The vines are said to taste and smell refreshing, and in Galar they're used as herbs.
description.guide: A Grass Pokémon made of a mass of blue vines that hide its body, with only its eyes and red feet showing. Its vines entangle anything that comes near and grow back if torn off. It evolves into Tangrowth when levelled up knowing Ancient Power.
description.tagline: A mystery wrapped in a never-ending tangle of vines

description.fun: Tangrowth's arms are bundles of vines that can stretch a long way, and if one breaks off, it simply grows back. It hunts by posing as a shrub, then grabbing prey, though it eats fruit too. In warm weather its vines grow so fast that even its eyes disappear, so it trims itself by tearing bits off.
description.guide: The evolution of Tangela, introduced in Generation 4, a large Grass Pokémon covered in a mass of blue vines with two long arms made of vines. It hunts by disguising itself as a shrub. Tangela evolves into it when levelled up knowing Ancient Power.
description.tagline: A walking shrub that trims its own vines
